_meta.source: BYOP workbook dumps (dumps/BYOP/00-09), program tabs 00-08 + 'MASTER EXERCISE LIBRARY'; raw/BYOP.xlsx used to confirm sheet visibility. Read-only; no Google Sheet modified.

evidence_legend.OBSERVED: read directly from a cell / data validation (tab + cell cited)

fields.slot: PURPOSE / CATEGORY(or DETAIL) labels, verbatim (stripped); purpose_verbatim / category_label_verbatim keep stray spaces
fields.category: library row-1 category of the column the EXERCISE dropdown points at (OBSERVED)
fields.implements: actual equipment of the filled exercise (classification INFERRED from its name) or, if unfilled, the family share of every selectable option in the dropdown range
fields.constraint: 1-5 external-constraint score (INFERRED rubric): 1 + path(0 free,1 cable/band/suspension/landmine/padded apparatus,2 machine) + support(0 single-leg/split/offset/airborne/hanging/field,1 standing bilateral/kneeling/plank,2 seated/lying/chest-supported) + reference point(+1 box/wall/ball contact), capped at 5. Filled slot = that exercise; unfilled = mean of the dropdown pool.
fields.velocity_intent: MAX | POWER | STRENGTH | CONTROLLED | ISOLATION | CORE | AEROBIC (INFERRED from category + exercise + prescribed reps; library row 6 'SPEED/POWER' on C/G/K is OBSERVED)
fields.slot_tier: coach-described order (1 speed/power, 2 power-strength, 3 strength, 4 resistance patterns, 5 isolation, 6 accessory) assigned per library column (INFERRED mapping of the coach's words)

access_tier.1: household props (step, box, bench, chair, towel, low obstacle)
access_tier.2: home kit (DB, KB, med ball, bands, TRX, pull-up/dip bar, stability ball, sandbag, plates)
access_tier.3: barbell family + rack/bench (barbell, EZ, hex, landmine)
access_tier.4: commercial gym (cable stack, selectorized/plate-loaded machines, GHD, reverse hyper, calorie erg)

family_legend.PROP: props (box, bench, step, plate-as-obstacle, hurdle, stability ball, sliders, sandbag)
family_legend.MACHINE: machine / padded station (fixed path or seated w/ pads, incl. lat pulldown, GHD, hyper bench)

velocity_legend.MAX: max velocity / reactive, BW or light (<=~10 lb med ball)
